_comment: Display groups for the By outcome view, added 2026-11-08 from the HG002 render (945 cards, 715 of them one-finding 'Gene expression of Affymetrix ID' cards). A group gathers findings into one card for navigation only: it is not a claim that the readouts are one trait, and it never absorbs a polygenic score or an action (those stay on their own trait key). A finding joins a group only when it cites one of the group's PMIDs AND its trait string is one of `exact` (literal, whitespace-trimmed) or starts with one of `prefixes`. Each finding keeps its own trait string in its details. Astra review 2026-11-08 asked for association wording, PMID scope and curated (not case-folded) equivalence.
